title: Al-Qari'ah 101:9-11 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 40 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Qari'ah 101:9-11 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 40. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ (٩) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ (١٠) نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ (١١)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: His refuge will be an abyss.
And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Qari'ah 101:9-11 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 101:9-11 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Say the du'a 'Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah' with a grown-up.
How many ayat are in Al-Qari'ah?
Think again: Al-Qari'ah ends with a warning about a hot Fire. What helps keep us safe from it?
questions.a: Believing in Allah, praying and good deeds; and asking Allah to protect us.
